01 / About

A broader perspective.
A structured approach.

Complex work rarely belongs to one discipline. My career started in psychology, research, and organizational development before expanding into UX research, business analysis, system implementation, operations, and project management.

That experience lets me examine problems from both the human and operational sides—understanding how people work, translating that into processes and requirements, and helping teams turn those requirements into workable systems and projects.

Business→Users→Process→Data→Technology
